data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 3.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to improvements of GBP 4.3 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.3 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.5 million on casualty reinsurance.

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate 6134 was not impacted by Hurricane Ian as much as the host syndicate as the majority of losses were in classes that the syndicate does not reinsure.

named_events.event_name: winter storm affecting 200 million people in the US
named_events.loss_description: closing the year with a "once in a generation" winter storm affecting 200 million people in the US.

Ultimately the impact of the war in the Ukraine will take many years to fully understand and that uncertainty will live on for a while longer. The affects are wide-ranging within the insurance market with multiple classes of business being called upon to help restore a semblance of order where needed.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 11.563 million, calculated from the claims development triangle for underwriting years 2019 and 2020. This contrasts with the narrative stating an overall net improvement of GBP 3.1 million on prior years' provisions. The net improvement was attributed to favourable development of GBP 4.3 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.3 million on marine reinsurance, partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.5 million on casualty reinsurance.
